study.title: Pemdi Aceh Tengah
study.tagline: Portal pemerintah digital untuk kabupaten di dataran tinggi Gayo.
study.problem: Informasi layanan publik kabupaten tersebar di banyak tempat dan sulit dijangkau warga. Portal resmi membutuhkan infrastruktur berbayar dan alur konten yang berat untuk dioperasikan satu orang — sementara kebutuhan sebenarnya: cepat, ringan, dan bisa dirawat dari mana saja.

approach.title: Static-first, deploy gratis
approach.text: Seluruh halaman dirender statis lalu di-host di Vercel — biaya nol, waktu muat cepat, dan tahan lonjakan trafik saat momen layanan ramai (penerimaan, cut bersama).

approach.title: Konten terstruktur in-repo
approach.text: Konten layanan hidup sebagai berkas dalam repositori — perubahan lewat git, terlacak siapa mengubah apa, bisa dikoreksi siapa saja lewat pull request.

approach.title: Aksesibilitas daratan tinggi
approach.text: Desain hemat kuota: tanpa pustaka berat, gambar terkompresi, dan tetap terbaca di koneksi lambat — khas jaringan dataran tinggi Gayo.

study.outcome: Portal non-resmi yang menjadi rujukan praktis layanan digital kabupaten, dirawat berkala, dan membuktikan pola "pemerintahan digital tanpa anggaran besar" yang bisa direplikasi kabupaten lain.

en.tagline: A digital government portal for a highland Gayo regency.
en.problem: Public service information for the regency was scattered and hard for residents to reach. An official portal would require paid infrastructure and a heavy publishing workflow for a one-person team — while the real need was: fast, light, and maintainable from anywhere.

approach.title: Static-first, free deploys
approach.text: Every page is rendered statically and hosted on Vercel — zero cost, fast loads, and resilient to traffic spikes during busy service seasons (enrollment, joint holidays).

approach.title: Structured content in-repo
approach.text: Service content lives as files in the repository — changes flow through git, who-changed-what is tracked, and anyone can submit corrections via pull request.

approach.title: Highland accessibility
approach.text: Data-frugal design: no heavy libraries, compressed images, and still readable on slow connections — typical of Gayo highland networks.

en.outcome: An unofficial portal that became a practical reference for the regency's digital services, maintained regularly, and proof of the "digital government without a big budget" pattern other regencies can replicate.
